identification: Cloud Native Buildpacks imgutil Go module

decisive_diff.description: Refactors transport selection into getTransport(insecure) and passes it to registry HEAD, GET, DELETE and Write as well as Image. TLS verification is disabled only when the caller selects the insecure registry option; false returns http.DefaultTransport. No other archive member changes.
decisive_diff.queue_premise: Fresh scans of predecessor and current release have identical traits, severities and classifier probabilities before edits. A no-detections predecessor was not supplied and could not be reproduced.

bcd.flow: BaseLayerBCD -> base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString -> gzip.NewReader -> ioutil.ReadAll -> WindowsBaseLayer tar.Writer -> UtilityVM/Files/EFI/Microsoft/Boot/BCD. local/remote prepareNewWindowsImage append this layer only to empty Windows images. No execution sink.
bcd.active_values: FirmwareModified=1; KeyName=BCD00000000; OS loader description=buildpacks.io; boot manager default points to that loader. Parsed NK/VK cells match the upstream tools/bcdhive_generator/bcdhive_hivex.go orderedEntries.
bcd.unc_header: The minimal-hive header contains a historical UNC filename; it is not an active BCD element or a network call. Generator begins with go-hivex/testdata/minimal.

busybox.archive_layout: 423 tar entries; 400 hardlinks; bin/[ contains the 1157408-byte multicall binary.
busybox.purpose: layout/layout_test.go reads the bundled busybox image to test layer/image manipulation. Program execution, network, permissions and user-ID capabilities are legitimate BusyBox applets; retain their detections.

reverse_engineering.context_limit: No deployment or caller configuration was provided. Verdict relies on source behavior, unchanged assets, complete version diff and original registry artifact verification, not on absence of detections.

trait_changes.preserved: Exact matchers, file/platform scope, confidence, notable severity and Docker identity exclusions. Updated both direct consumers. Removed unsupported inherited T1056 and T1552.001 mappings from relocated text observations. Other source rules retained.
trait_changes.placement: Registry configuration/authentication vocabulary belongs to metadata/lang/source/naming/setting. Quoted auths key syntax belongs to metadata/lang/source/syntax/key-value. Neither alone establishes credential acquisition.
trait_changes.selector_decision: Neutral configuration text no longer contributes directly through credential-access ancestor selectors. Registry/password direct consumer and Docker path-plus-read consumer retain their exact evidence. No added replacement legs that would restore unsupported credential-theft inference.
trait_changes.legacy_entropy_note: near-maximum-entropy-file accurately describes whole-file entropy. Its YAML explicitly documents validator-pinned broad archive scope pending coordinated engine migration; unchanged.

verification.before_after_controls: All nine controls retain all findings and severities after the two ID substitutions. Password recording remains suspicious; two existing credential-gated execution controls remain hostile; Docker path/read consumer remains notable; config-only and near-miss controls are covered.
verification.sample_comparison: All findings and severities preserved in every one of the 49 analyzed units after ID mapping. Only the outer aggregate and two testhelper Go files have relocated IDs. BCD and decoded layer remain unchanged.

classifier.json_state_before_and_after: Both emit cls=0, lvl=-1 and conf=0. Numeric route probabilities are not calibrated final verdict confidences.
classifier.model_warning: The installed v18 model reports that the extractor uses a newer feature spec and supplies newer features as zeros.

remaining_disagreements: binary/embedded/base64-gz is engine-emitted with suspicious severity and T1027.009 based only on format magic. The 913-byte gzip encoding observation is accurate, but concealment is not supported by this BCD asset. YAML cannot change its built-in severity in the reviewed implementation. Retained the observation; did not suppress it, introduce a shadow rule or widen generated-source exclusions.
Live classifier is BENIGN, consistent with review; the residual suspicious format label overstates this resource.
